items.mainDefect: Concurrent builds for the same resource can both call bleve.New on the same directory, causing file-backed index creation to fail with 'path already exists'.

secondary.defect: Concurrent memory-index builds can overwrite an index in the cache without closing it, leaking the displaced index.

items.mainDefect: NewResourceServer now blocks on synchronous initialization, including the full search index build.

secondary.defect: Initialization failures now abort server construction instead of surfacing lazily through initErr.
Existing callers that invoke Init after construction were not updated for initialization now happening inside the constructor.
